authority.purpose: Product requirement and upstream command disposition ledger; it is not implementation-completion evidence.
authority.status_rule: A requirement is complete only when implementation_evidence proves the full accepted contract on the current exact source.
authority.integration_rule: Commands may share a public command path only when problem definition, required and forbidden inputs, result contract, and guided Modal schema are identical.
authority.algorithm_timeout_rule: algorithm_family selects semantic execution authority; timeout_class selects resource policy. Neither may be inferred from the other.

runtime_projection.authority_note: This describes the current Discord runtime and is intentionally independent of target capability v2 schema and result IDs.

alias_decisions.rationale: The top-level spellings retain generic legacy request and result contracts; only canonical pc chance owns the typed v2 product contract.
Top-level score retains the generic Jstris Ultra preset contract; only canonical pc score owns the typed v2 problem and score-summary result contracts.
They share the setup coordinator and form but retain explicit ranking-priority semantic subcommands.
The request is fieldwise identical to Build cover only after the fixed finesse=inputs and mirror=exclude preset.
Saves reports grouped probabilities; best-save selects a ranked representative witness.
PC has a fixed clear-to-empty goal and forbids target; Build requires base plus target delta.
Target generation and supplied-solution evaluation use different required inputs, Modals, and result contracts.
Forward spin consumes ordered queue/pattern with hold; structure search consumes unordered inventory with no hold.
One requires one exact queue and returns a witness; the other accepts a pattern and returns queue-universe probability.
Current shared occupancy lowering is a feature gap, not evidence of semantic equivalence; preserve dedicated contracts until each meaning is implemented.

release_readiness.policy: The v0.8.0 validator must fail while any required capability, result-affecting option, or accepted requirement remains partial or missing.

exclusions.reason: Per-guild text prefixes and ambient game state are not product request semantics.
Shutdown, purge, and destructive host administration are outside the user command surface.
Arbitrary sfinder or subprocess argument execution is not an accepted typed boundary.
A server-side per-user filesystem is replaced by bounded typed attachments and artifacts.
Internal process enumeration and kill commands are replaced by typed request cancellation.
Meme, harassment, and message-manipulation commands are outside Clearra search and utility scope.
Newsletter and unrelated media generation are outside the v0.8.0 product contract.
Third-party leaderboard scraping is not a deterministic Clearra capability.
Upstream blacklist and database administration are not copied into Clearra.
Upstream administrator and database views expose ambient privileged state.
Executing a command as another user violates the product authority boundary.
Image recognition, palette calibration, and image-to-Fumen inference are outside the v0.8.0 typed deterministic document boundary; native typed Fumen encoding remains supported separately.

requirements.summary: Maintain a complete pinned upstream command and prior-request ledger.
Use problem-family roots instead of one /search while preserving distinct required inputs, result contracts, and Modal schemas.
Expose every result-affecting GUI option through a named Discord option, semantic subcommand preset, advanced objective, or explicit exclusion.
Keep advanced objective off slash and Modal surfaces while documenting it only through layered objective help.
Keep verify as an undiscoverable text-only diagnostic with no slash, Modal, autocomplete, or help exposure.
Add PC All-Spin witness and preservation-probability contracts without denominator duplication or target-field support.
Add Build hold/source/height/aggregation/profile/B2B/finesse/mirror and new observation, probability, portfolio, failed-queue, and score semantics.
Integrate finesse search as a Build preset and finesse score as a distinct Build document-evaluation subcommand.
Keep unordered no-hold spin-structure search separate from ordered forward spin, including cover and guaranteed variants.
Make SupplyExecutionAutomaton the shared supply-transition owner across applicable search families.
Preserve B2B/spin edge evidence and emit a stage-by-stage SolutionSetAuditReport.
Provide typed equivalent-coverage classes, portfolio families, deterministic representatives, lazy paging, and two-pass minimum cover.
Provide durable delegation leases with acknowledgement-before-publication and native, browser, and test journals.
Provide typed artifact encoders, sinks, compression, comment layout, and atomic CLI output contracts.
Represent availability and shared compute/memory leases without silently converting incomplete work into empty complete results.
Revalidate prior terminal Hold, codec, Setup, Player, CTK, text-command identity, security, and performance claims on the final source.
Release and deploy exactly one accepted v0.8.0 source without reusing v0.7.5 candidate authority or proof.
Generate or validate slash catalog, text allowlist, EN/KO help, Modal selection, result allowlist, timeout, and telemetry identity from this registry.
Retain compatibility slash aliases for two released versions and text aliases long-term only when typed requests are fieldwise identical.
Re-audit upstream drift at implementation start and release freeze while retaining pinned provenance.
Expose every exact optimal portfolio alternative through result-bound lazy GUI and explicit durable CLI paging while Discord selects one canonical portfolio and score ties never use attack.
